hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: MDOT publishes no crash-cost table: its HSIP report says projects are ranked by benefit/cost from Safety Countermeasure Alternative Reports, but the unit costs aren't published (HSIP 2025, 'Program Methodology')

statewide_rates.missing: MDOT publishes no statewide average crash-rate table, and CrashIQ has no Mississippi traffic counts

screening.state_method: MDOT HSIP project identification: crash frequency, crash rate, excess proportions of specific crash types, relative severity index (HSIP 2025 report, 'Program Methodology'; text extract, page not recorded)

min_years.missing: MDOT states no minimum years for a corridor study; its HSIP evaluates projects on a five-year before-and-after crash analysis (HSIP 2025 report, 'Program Evaluation'), which is an evaluation window, not a study minimum

spf_calibration.missing: MDOT's 2020 SPF calibration report (mdot_spf_2020) publishes Mississippi calibration factors for HSM SPFs on US and state highways; not loaded (no SPF engine, no Mississippi traffic counts)
